explication: Awesome Common Lisp is a static, curated catalog rather than an executable application. A reader consults the README and browses its subject sections to find libraries and other resources; the README says listed libraries are generally available through Quicklisp and marks community standards and recommended projects. The tree contains no implementation source, so this map represents documented catalog sections only, not runtime behavior or links between entries.
